### Enthusiasm and Experience
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/enthusiasm-and-experience-one-year-devotions-for-men-november-3.html
Passage: Ezra 3:12
Points:
- Younger generations tend to look ahead to the future, while older generations reflect back on the past.
- The laying of the temple foundation prompted opposite reactions: the young shouted with delight while the elders wept in dismay.
- The indistinguishable blend of shouts and weeping showed that both perspectives held valid insights.
- Youthful enthusiasm without the wisdom of experience risks collapse, while experience devoid of enthusiasm never moves forward.
- God intentionally created both stages of life so that experience and enthusiasm can support each other.

### Shouting and Weeping
Author: Owen Strachan
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/shouting-and-weeping
Passage: Ezra 3:11-13
Points:
- Laying the foundation of the rebuilt temple produced an intensely emotional worship ceremony.
- One group shouted for joy as they celebrated the restoration of God's presence and their covenant identity.
- Another group wept loudly as they recalled the lost splendor of Solomon's original temple.
- In the new covenant, Jesus Christ Himself—rather than a physical building—is the foundation of God's kingdom.
- Christians share this tension of sorrow and joy, mourning loss while celebrating the purchase of redemption.
